cap_status_semantics.UNKNOWN: No ceiling is enforced or reported as a percentage; percent_of_max is null. Limit UNKNOWN is a pass-with-warning world (FIX-PLAN C6).

counting_convention: NFC-normalized, trimmed, Unicode code points, per Image Guide v5 (FIX-PLAN conflict N3). The shared enforcer counts len(text.strip()); the two counts can differ and are not interchangeable.

default.source: No policy entry matched the model id. Ceiling not enforced; percent_of_max recorded as null.

models.source: GPT Image 2.5 cap 20,000 per KIE docs 2026-09-09 as recorded by Skill 66; NOT owner-confirmed (FIX-PLAN Part C-rule 5).

Skill 66: GPT Image 2 authoritative cap is 25,000, OWNER_CONFIRMED 2026-08-27, warn-only. The shared enforcer's embedded table lists 20,000, which Skill 66 calls stale; the owner-confirmed value governs inside Skill 71 until Trevor rules otherwise (FIX-PLAN C8, Part C-rule 5). The divergence is also pinned in references/external-authorities.json.

Skill 66 records the Qwen class limit as 4.5K TOKENS. Token-limited models are checked in tokens, never converted to a fake character cap; this validator has no tokenizer and does not judge token counts (Part C-rule 2). Character telemetry is still recorded.

purpose: Prompt-budget policy layer for Skill 71 (FIX-PLAN Amendment 6, Part C). Element completeness governs prompt acceptance; length is telemetry only. The model maximum is a hard ceiling ONLY where a VERIFIED cap exists, under Skill 66's cap-status semantics, which govern inside Skill 71 and supersede the shared enforcer's blind 95-to-100 percent band (Part C-rule 2). There is no percentage floor at any level (Part C-rule 3).
tripwire_meaning: A complete prompt under tripwire_chars is flagged for manual element re-inspection by the reviewer, recorded in the review file. It is NOT an automatic failure (Part C-rule 3). Basis: the guide's four measured complete teaching prompts run 9,475 to 9,906 characters; no complete prompt in this system has been observed below roughly 9,000.
